name: Network router symbol
summary: Network symbol for a router, a circle or box with outward arrows, that connects separate IP networks.
description: Routers forward traffic between separate networks, such as a plant network and a remote access link. Drawings commonly use a circle with four outward arrows. Industrial routers may also include cellular modems and firewall functions.

On electrical drawings the router appears in communication cabinets with its supply, antenna connection for cellular types and its WAN and LAN ports. Remote access to protection or SCADA equipment often passes through it. The symbol does not show routing tables, VPN configuration or firewall rules.
distinction: A switch forwards within one network; a router connects networks and often enforces security policy.
